resources.string: Paste a job, visa or scholarship message and check it for warning signs.
Check whether you meet the age limit in a job advertisement. Works offline.
Your text is sent securely to RAAHI to be checked in memory. It is not stored or logged. Do not paste passwords or OTPs.
Paste the message or tick at least one box.
No connection. The scam check needs the internet.
The scam check is not available right now. Please try again later.
Too many checks. Please wait a minute.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
I was asked to pay before getting the job, visa or award.
Payment is requested to a personal account or wallet.
The only contact is WhatsApp, Telegram or social media.
There is no interview, test or qualification check.
No BE&OE licence number was given, or it does not match the official list.
I am being pressured to decide quickly.
A guaranteed visa, job or admission is promised.
I would travel on a visit visa or skip the protector.
I was asked for an OTP, PIN or password.
I verified the agent or organisation on the official website.
Enter a real date of birth.
Enter a real date for the closing date.
The date of birth must be before the closing date.
Within the limit (counted to the day)
Last day you still meet it (completed years): %s
Last day you still meet it (to the day): %s
Advertisements use either reading. If it says \"not exceeding N years\", the first usually applies. Read the advertisement, and ask the department if unsure.
